title: AFKZonePlus
description: AFK Currency Rewards | Per-World Zones, Multi-Language & Folia
body:
![AFKZonePlus](https://i.imgur.com/GqGzClA.png)

## About AFKZonePlus

AFKZonePlus rewards players for staying AFK in the worlds you choose, with a fully customizable currency, an action-bar countdown and a reward sound.

Set your AFK zones, your reward rate and your own currency name, and let every player read the messages in their own language.

## Highlights

- **AFK currency rewards by world** earn while standing in any AFK zone
- **Per-player languages** messages shown in each player's own client language
- **Your own currency** the currency id is also its command (e.g. `/rune`)
- **Flexible storage** File, MongoDB or SQL, with optional Redis cache

## Compatibility

- Java 21 or higher
- Spigot, Paper and Folia (1.21+)
- **Requires the free Nexus core plugin** → [Download the latest Nexus](https://github.com/MrNickax/Nexus/releases/latest) (install it alongside AFKZonePlus)

## Features

- Reward a configurable amount on a configurable interval while in an AFK world
- VIP permission to keep earning outside AFK worlds
- Live action-bar countdown to the next reward, plus a reward notification
- Optional reward sound (configurable sound, volume & pitch)
- Name your own currency, it becomes the in-game command
- Per-player localization, drop a *lang/<language>.yml* file (English & Spanish included)
- Modern formatting with MiniMessage (gradients, HEX), plus Legacy and Mixed modes
- Pluggable storage: File, MongoDB or SQL, with in-memory or Redis cache and optional write-behind
- PlaceholderAPI support: `%afkzoneplus_balance%`
- Admin commands to check, add and take currency
- Folia-safe, reload-safe (PlugMan-friendly), with a built-in debug mode

## Commands

The currency command name is your configured currency id (default `rune`).

- `/<currency> balance [player]` → Show your balance, or another player's
- `/<currency> add <player> <amount>` → Add currency to a player
- `/<currency> take <player> <amount>` → Take currency from a player
- `/afkzoneplus reload` → Reload the configuration and language files

## Permissions

- `afkzoneplus.vip` → Keep earning outside AFK worlds (node is configurable)
- `afkzoneplus.currency.balance.others` → Check another player's balance
- `afkzoneplus.currency.add` → Use the add command
- `afkzoneplus.currency.take` → Use the take command
- `afkzoneplus.reload` → Reload the plugin

## Why AFKZonePlus?

AFK farming should feel rewarding, not generic. AFKZonePlus gives you a currency you fully own, your name, your reward rate, your zones, with modern formatting, real storage options and first-class per-player localization, all while staying lightweight and fully compatible with the latest server software, including Folia.
